description: This file defines a React functional component named UserDashboard, which manages user-related data, API interactions, and UI rendering for a user dashboard page in a web application. It includes state management, effect hooks for data fetching, token handling, and rendering subcomponents for key creation and viewing.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Utility function to retrieve a cookie value by name from document.cookie.

methods.name: formatUserRole
methods.description: Converts raw user role string to a more user-friendly display string.

methods.name: gotoLogin
methods.description: Clears cookies and redirects the user to the login/sso page.
